items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: Celestan on trumpet, beat the Polkhoz on trumpet, Louis Armstrong on trumpet.

ctx.x: Did he play both sometime in the tuxedo and sometime in the onward band? Yeah.

Yeah, he played with both of them. See, in other words he played with the onward band before he did the tuxedo. See, tuxedos came after the onward band. I see. See, the onward band is an older band than the tuxedo one. Yeah, that's right. So after the onward band broke up, well, those tuxedos came in. See, well, Old Man Barbaran and Old Man Alexander, well, they joined the tuxedo band. Yeah. And they made the tuxedo band. Celestan on trumpet, beat the Polkhoz on trumpet, Louis Armstrong on trumpet. Oh, yeah.
Three trubbles. How did Louis sound in those days? Oh, it was all right.
